prompt: In a labeled temp vault, run wiki-synthesize to find co-occurring concept pairs lacking a synthesis/ page.
expected_output: Co-occurrence scan skipping specials; filter already-covered synthesis pairs; top-N scored candidates; draft synthesis pages with full template; report skipped candidates.

assertions.text: Skips specials index.md, log.md, hot.md, _insights.md, _meta/*, _archives/*, _raw/* from the co-occurrence scan
Filters out pairs already covered by existing synthesis/ pages before drafting
Ranks candidates with the score table (co-occurrence, cross-domain, hub tags, contradiction resolution) and picks top 5
Lists skipped next-10 candidates after creating pages for the top set
